name: Elephantbird cart
notes: A two-wheeled cart drawn by a Steppe-Plumed Elephantbird, the shaggy ratite merchants tamed for burden on the coast roads. Faster than an ox and less patient; it walks at the pace it chooses and the driver walks beside it. The owner's paintings of every cart road between the maps, 1 October 2026, draw this bird in the shafts, and Kunch has always gone about 'up on a bird' -- so the roads moved to the art.
sources: the owner's road and opening paintings, 2026-10-01
